meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.coverage: External commercial borrowings registered each month since April 2004 under the earlier classification: number, amount, automatic and approval routes, maturity, interest, and borrower industries
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 55, US$ million (counts as numbers, maturity in years, rates in per cent). The classification in force before the January 2025 revision; DBIE carries its borrower lines to February 2026. Lines are keyed by the year their classification took effect.
